I'll keep the first layout — the labels down the left side.

My reasoning: both filter exactly the same, so it comes down to how it'll feel as my collection grows. That row of buttons across the top looks clean now with four labels, but I know I'll end up with a lot more labels over time, and a single row will start wrapping and getting crowded. A list down the side has room to keep growing without feeling messy. It also gave the "All bookmarks" and "Read later" shortcuts a natural home right up top, which I liked — it feels like a proper little navigation area for getting around my collection.

So: the left-side label list is the one I want to keep.
